svg.title: Adam Rudavský · XVADUR · measured record
svg.desc: Measurement board for Adam Rudavský (XVADUR), snapshot 2026-10-13: 646,607 human words indexed in Korpus (2026-01-17 to 2026-10-12); 159 writing days; 588 workspace commits across 13 local repositories (2026-09-02 to 2026-10-11); Codex reports 22.4B lifetime tokens and Claude Code reports 14.4B total tokens, both from screenshots received 2026-10-11.
